policy.rule: A workstream may prepare hooks/config parsers before device testing, but must not promote a capability to validated.

workstreams.name: 10-bit still and color pipeline
workstreams.goal: Enable real high-bit-depth still capture and preserve wide-gamut/HDR metadata end-to-end.
workstreams.evidence_gate: Do not call complete until final-file bit depth and color metadata are validated.

workstreams.name: Professional video pipeline
workstreams.goal: Expose the platform's professional video ceiling without inventing unsupported sensor modes.
workstreams.evidence_gate: 4K120 requires target sensor-mode and sustained-stream evidence; LOG requires real 10-bit/transfer-function metadata.
donor_refs: OPPO Find X9 same LYT-808 sensor

workstreams.name: RAW and computational RAW
workstreams.goal: Map and expand RAW precision, RAW fusion and high-quality output modes.
workstreams.evidence_gate: Container bit depth, sensor source precision and computational output precision must be distinguished.

workstreams.name: Master and Hasselblad controls
workstreams.goal: Expose useful manual controls and Hasselblad high-resolution paths already compatible with target optics.
workstreams.evidence_gate: Controls must alter real capture requests/output, not only render UI.

workstreams.name: Telephoto, zoom and multi-exposure
workstreams.goal: Exploit the LYT-600 telephoto and Snapdragon computational HDR path for higher-quality zoom and stage/action capture.
workstreams.evidence_gate: Zoom features must be evaluated for real detail retention and seamless lens transitions, not UI zoom limits.
donor_refs: OPPO Find X9 Stage/Super Zoom behavior
